sentences.text: ORAL ORDER
This Criminal Revision Application is taken up for settlement in Lok Adalat, today.
Learned APP Shri K. L. Pandya appearing on behalf of the respondent-State has produced Withdrawal/Settlement purshis, which is taken on record.

Today, Mr. S. C. Desai, Food Safety Officer (I. Card No. 19680) from the Surat Municipal Corporation, Surat is present before the Court and states that as the matter is placed in the Lok Adalat before this Court and if the applicant is ready and willing to deposit the amount of fine, he has no objection, if the matter be disposed of.
In view of the withdrawal / settlement pursis moved by the parties under the signature as well as learned advocate appearing on behalf of the parties.
R/CR.RA/517/2015 ORDER

As such, on going through the record, it is noticed that the offence alleged against the original accused-revisionist under the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 is not serious in nature and the punishment or penalty for such offence is not substantial, and in Bharatbhai Vithalbhai Viradia vs State Of Gujarat on 22 April, 2018 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/171561648/
1 view of the provisions of Sections 51 and 52 of the Food Safety & Standards Act, 2006, it is compoundable under Section 69 of the said Act.

sentences.text:
It is pointed out that by virtue of an Order dated 4th September 2015 passed by this Court, pending hearing and final disposal of the present Criminal Revision Application, the execution,
implementation and operation of the impugned judgment and order of conviction and sentence dated 19th January 2013 passed by the learned J.M.F.C., Municipal Court, Surat in P.F.A. Case No.
10 of 2013, which was confirmed by the learned 12th Adhoc Additional Sessions Judge, Surat vide judgment and order passed in Criminal Appeal No. 28 of 2013 dated 31.08.2015 has been suspended and the applicant/revisionist is ordered to be released on bail.
In view of purshis of the parties, the present Criminal Revision Application stands disposed of.

The applicant/revisionist is hereby directed to pay fine of Rs. 25,000/= [Rupees Twenty Five thousand only] before the High Court Legal Services Committee, High Court of Gujarat Complex, Ahmedabad within a period of four weeks of this Order; as agreed, failing which the Criminal Revision Application shall stand revived automatically.

entities.text: High Court Legal Services Committee, High Court of Gujarat Complex, Ahmedabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Accordingly, this Criminal Revision Application stands R/CR.RA/517/2015 ORDER disposed of as settled on payment of fine; as aforestated.

The judgment and order of conviction and sentence dated 19th January 2013 passed by the learned J.M.F.C., Municipal Court, Surat in P.F.A. Case No. 10 of 2013, which was confirmed by the learned 12th Adhoc Additional Sessions Judge, Surat vide judgment and order passed in Criminal Appeal No. 28 of 2013 dated 31.08.2015 stands modified by converting the same into fine of Rs. 25,000/= [Rupees Twenty Five thousand only].
Bail bonds stand cancelled.
R&P; if any, be transmitted back to the trial Court.

It is required to be mentioned here that disposal of this matter will not in any way affect any connected cases arising out of the same, incident or any other proceedings, filed or to be filed before any other Court.
It is also required to be noted that this Order will not be treated as precedent in any future cases for reference.

(B.N. KARIA, J) Chairman ksdarji Bharatbhai Vithalbhai Viradia vs State Of Gujarat on 22 April, 2018 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/171561648/
